input.quote: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 19 is the only responsive clause and it is a no-hire, not a non-solicit: it bars each party (and its affiliates) from hiring "any employee of the other party" for the term plus one year, with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-outs. A no-hire covering all personnel is walk-away territory under this rule, so it fails the fallback on material terms even though it is mutual. We have redlined to the fallback: mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months after involvement ends, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and express confirmation that hiring is not prohibited.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.

proposal.summary: Replace the mutual no-hire with a fallback mutual non-solicit limited to involved personnel for 12 months, with carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 19 is a no-hire covering all of the other party's employees, which is walk-away for us; we have narrowed it to a mutual non-solicit of personnel directly involved in the services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with the customary general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no hiring prohibition.

ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: Neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who is directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement, during such involvement and for a period of twelve (12) months after that person's involvement ends. This restriction does not prohibit hiring, and does not apply to general advertisements or other general solicitations not targeted at the other party's personnel, or to responses to unsolicited approaches by such persons.
